mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS file_record ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, file_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, biz_type VARCHAR(64), biz_id VARCHAR(128), original_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, object_key VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, bucket_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, content_type VARCHAR(128), file_size BIGINT NOT NULL, file_md5 CHAR(32) NOT NULL, file_ext VARCHAR(32), storage_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, upload_type VARCHAR(32), tags TEXT, reference_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY uk_file_record_file_id (file_id), KEY idx_file_record_owner_md5_size (owner_id, file_md5, file_size), KEY idx_file_record_owner_biz (owner_id, biz_type, biz_id), KEY idx_file_record_status_created_at (status, created_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS file_reference ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, file_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, reference_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, reference_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY uk_file_reference_owner_file_reference (owner_id, file_id, reference_type, reference_id), KEY idx_file_reference_owner_file (owner_id, file_id), KEY idx_file_reference_owner_reference (owner_id, reference_type, reference_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
UPDATE file_record SET biz_type = #{bizType}, biz_id = #{bizId}, tags = #{tags}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND status = 'NORMAL'

UPDATE file_record SET reference_count = CASE WHEN COALESCE(reference_count, 0) <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE reference_count - 1 END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND status = 'NORMAL'
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_id, owner_id, biz_type, biz_id, original_name, object_key, bucket_name, content_type, file_size, file_md5, file_ext, storage_type, upload_type, tags, COALESCE(reference_count, 0) AS reference_count, status, created_at, updated_at FROM file_record WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND status = 'NORMAL' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE file_record SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND status = 'NORMAL' AND COALESCE(reference_count, 0) = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM file_reference WHERE file_reference.owner_id = file_record.owner_id AND file_reference.file_id = file_record.file_id )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM file_record WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'NORMAL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file_record WHERE status = 'NORMAL' AND created_at >= #{createdAt}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM file_record WHERE status = 'NORMAL'

SELECT id, file_id, owner_id, biz_type, biz_id, original_name, object_key, bucket_name, content_type, file_size, file_md5, file_ext, storage_type, upload_type, tags, COALESCE(reference_count, 0) AS reference_count, status, created_at, updated_at FROM file_record WHERE status = 'DELETED' AND updated_at <= #{updatedBefore} AND COALESCE(reference_count, 0) = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM file_reference WHERE file_reference.owner_id = file_record.owner_id AND file_reference.file_id = file_record.file_id ) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, file_id, owner_id, biz_type, biz_id, original_name, object_key, bucket_name, content_type, file_size, file_md5, file_ext, storage_type, upload_type, tags, COALESCE(reference_count, 0) AS reference_count, status, created_at, updated_at FROM file_record WHERE id > #{lastId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, file_id, owner_id, biz_type, biz_id, original_name, object_key, bucket_name, content_type, file_size, file_md5, file_ext, storage_type, upload_type, tags, COALESCE(reference_count, 0) AS reference_count, status, created_at, updated_at FROM file_record WHERE status = 'NORMAL' AND id > #{lastId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
